short_term: The character becomes paralyzed, blinded, or deafened for 1d10 minutes.
The character becomes incapacitated and spends 1d10 minutes screaming, laughing, or weeping.
The character is frightened and must run away from any source of fear for 1d10 minutes.
The character babble incoherently and can't speak or cast spells for 1d10 minutes.
The character experiences vivid hallucinations and has disadvantage on ability checks for 1d10 minutes.
The character is compelled to eat or drink anything they see (soil, potion, sewage) for 1d10 minutes.
The character is stunned for 1d10 minutes, frozen in place.
The character falls unconscious for 1d10 minutes.
long_term: The character experiences vivid hallucinations and has disadvantage on all ability checks and attack rolls. Lasts 1d10 x 10 hours.
The character suffers intense paranoia, believing everyone is conspiring against them. Lasts 1d10 x 10 hours.
The character falls into a catatonic stupor, completely unresponsive. Lasts 1d10 x 10 hours.
The character becomes convinced that they are a different creature entirely. Lasts 1d10 x 10 hours.
The character loses the ability to speak, communicating only in hand gestures and screams. Lasts 1d10 x 10 hours.
The character develops an uncontrollable tic or twitch that gives them disadvantage on stealth and dexterity checks. Lasts 1d10 x 10 hours.
The character becomes intensely greedy and will steal anything shiny they see. Lasts 1d10 x 10 hours.
indefinite: The character regards something common as repulsive (e.g., money, taverns, spellcasting). Cured only by Greater Restoration or Heal.
The character is convinced that they are the absolute strongest person alive, ignoring safety.
The character is terrified of a specific common creature (e.g., spiders, dogs, horses) and cannot look at them without shaking.
The character is incredibly stubborn and refuses to accept that they could ever be wrong about anything.
The character hoards all food, items, and garbage they find, refusing to share with the party.
